subject: SOC 2 renewal: evidence upload, bridge acceptance, and procurement checklist
messages:
From: Dave O'Neill <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence for renewal (deadline May 15)

Hi Rachel,

We're starting the final procurement review for our renewal (contract GLH-4872). Procurement needs the latest SOC 2 Type II report (unredacted control sections preferred) or, if the Type II for the new period isn't available yet, a firm bridge letter that covers audit-period continuity through our renewal date. Our renewal cutoff is 2027-05-15 and legal flagged that the bridge must explicitly state the audit coverage dates and the auditor's name.

Could you confirm:
- Whether you can provide the full Type II report for the period ending 2026-09-30, or alternatively a bridge letter that covers until at least 2027-07-31?
- How you'll deliver the report (secure upload vs DocuSign for bridge acceptance).
- Any procurement checklist / invoice needed to finalize purchase order by 2027-05-10.

Please loop in whoever on your side handles SOC 2 evidence. We're happy to accept redacted reports as long as control testing dates are visible.

Thanks,
Dave O'Neill
Director of Procurement
Greenline Health

Attachment: procurement_requirements_GLH.pdf (stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Dave O'Neill <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence for renewal (deadline May 15)

Hi Dave — thanks for the clear note and the deadline. Short answers up front: we can provide the 2026 Type II report redacted for customer-sensitive detail and we can also provide a signed bridge letter covering audit-period continuity through 2027-07-31 if you need it for procurement gating.

What we'll provide by EOD 2027-04-21:
- SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf (redacted: control testing results remain visible)
- Bridge-Letter-Redacted-Template.docx (signed PDF via DocuSign)
- renewal-procurement-checklist-GLH.xlsx (items to attach to PO)

A couple of asks from our side to close this quickly:
1) Please confirm the exact audit testing period you need recorded in the report/bridge (we expect the report to show testing Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 30, 2026).
2) Do you need the auditor name included in the bridge? We can include Redwood's auditor (Bexley LLP).
3) Preferred transfer method: secure Drive link (we'll redact and set access), or an S3 pre-signed upload link if you prefer direct ingest to your procurement portal.

I'll upload the redacted report to a secure Drive and share the link once Neha signs off on redactions. Attaching the procurement checklist draft for your review.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: renewal-procurement-checklist-GLH.xlsx (stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: redaction & bridge note

Rachel — quick internal: I reviewed the draft redactions for the 2026 Type II. We need to keep the control testing windows, auditor statement, and management assertion verbatim; redact customer's names in example logs and any customer-specific config screenshots. I'll attach the redaction map to the Drive upload.

For the bridge letter: use the standard template but include:
- Auditor: Bexley LLP
- Coverage statement: confirms continuous coverage from 2026-10-01 through 2027-07-31
- Signature: Head of Compliance (Marissa can e-sign via DocuSign)

Also flagging to Finance that Greenline may require an invoice by 2027-05-10 to issue the PO. Rachel, loop me in on the Drive link so I can confirm before we send.

Neha
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Dave O'Neill <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence for renewal (deadline May 15)

Thanks — that timeline works. A couple of clarifications so our legal/procurement team can sign off:
- We will accept a redacted Type II report that shows the control testing period Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 30, 2026.
- We confirm the bridge letter must include auditor name (Bexley LLP) and a clear coverage end-date; acceptance threshold is bridge covering at least until 2027-07-31.
- Preferred delivery: secure S3 pre-signed upload to our procurement portal (I can send the link if you want).
- We do require an invoice and a completed procurement checklist to be attached to the PO request.

If you can upload the report and the signed bridge by 2027-04-21 EOD our legal will be able to complete the renewal by 2027-05-10.

Best,
Dave
Greenline Health

Reference: procurement portal upload instructions (portal-upload-instructions.pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Dave O'Neill <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence for renewal (deadline May 15)

Dave — confirming next steps completed:
- SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf (redacted per Neha's map) uploaded to secure Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/secure/SOC2-GLH-2026
- Bridge-Letter signed and sent via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/BRIDGE-GLH-001 (signed by Marissa, includes auditor name and coverage through 2027-07-31)
- renewal-procurement-checklist-GLH.xlsx attached and pre-filled where possible (line items for invoice and PO).
- Invoice draft has been sent to finance@greenlinehealth.com per your portal instructions — please confirm receipt.

Attachments included here as well: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf, Bridge-Letter-Redacted-Template.docx (signed PDF delivered), renewal-procurement-checklist-GLH.xlsx. If you prefer S3 ingest, we can also deliver a pre-signed link — let me know and we'll push to your portal.

Thanks for the quick coordination. Marissa / Neha — happy to hand off any further legal/PO items.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
